# President Trump expected to rally in SC ahead of GOP Senate runoff

President-elect Donald Trump speaks at a rally in Zebulon, Georgia in 2024. (File photo by Ross Williams/Georgia Recorder)

President Donald Trump is expected to hold a rally in Myrtle Beach on Friday, the last day of early voting in the GOP runoff for U.S. Senate, according to a release Monday by the state Republican Party. results.title: President Trump expected to rally in SC ahead of GOP Senate runoff

results.content:
Reports indicate the president will hold a rally in Myrtle Beach on Friday, Aug. 21.

The South Carolina Republican Party postponed Friday’s U.S. Senate primary stump event in Anderson County due to Trump’s visit, announcing Monday that it is rescheduling so both candidates can participate.

--> Also read: ‘We love you’: Trump honors Fort Bragg soldiers, 2 others killed in Middle East [...] While specific details about Trump’s rally remain unreleased, he has endorsed Sen. Darline Graham in her Aug. 25 runoff against Rep. Ralph Norman. The runoff winner will face Democratic nominee Dr. Annie Andrews in the November general election.
